result.summary: Rewrote lib/letflow/design/req203-artifact-activation.md §2.4 point 1 to state, with source citation (deps/ecto/lib/ecto/type.ex:1007, cast_field/9 -> filter_values/5 in deps/ecto/lib/ecto/changeset.ex) and the validator's own empirical Ecto 3.14.1 run, that validate_required(:rationale) via cast/4's default trim-leading/empty-value pipeline correctly rejects nil, literal "", and whitespace-only strings such as "   " -- all three reduce to nil before validate_required/2 runs, because String.trim_leading("   ") == "" and "" is a member of the default empty_values. No validate_length/validate_change addition is needed at the changeset level. Narrowed the genuinely-open gap to non-leading whitespace around real content (e.g. " x "), which trim_leading does not touch, since trim_leading strips only leading whitespace. For the DB CHECK (point 2), added an explicit finding that CHECK (rationale <> '') does NOT independently catch a whitespace-only string for a changeset-bypassing write path (a raw SQL insert of '   ' passes '   ' <> ''), and added a new decision paragraph: this residual gap is ACCEPTED, not fixed by strengthening to btrim(rationale) <> '', because this design defines no changeset-bypassing writer for either table (per its own §8/§4) -- every writer goes through the changeset where whitespace-only is already rejected -- mirroring REQ-202's precedent of accepting a residual gap that has no real call path in this codebase. Flagged that a future changeset-bypassing bulk writer would need to revisit this. Replaced the old 'decided out of scope' closing paragraph (which incorrectly conflated the whitespace-only case with the narrower non-leading-whitespace-around-content case) with a correctly-scoped closing paragraph naming only the true remaining gap (" x "-shaped input) as the accepted non-goal. Updated §10's AC6 row to match: changeset validate_required now correctly credited with rejecting nil/""/whitespace-only; DB CHECK's own whitespace-only gap and its acceptance reasoning summarized; only the non-leading-whitespace-around-content case named as the stated non-goal. Did not touch §2.2, §4.1, §4.2, or §7 (OQ-A/OQ-E/OQ-F content), confirmed unchanged by re-reading the diff before commit. Final decision on the DB CHECK's whitespace-only gap: ACCEPTED as-is (no btrim strengthening), because no changeset-bypassing writer exists in this design's scope; if one is added later, the CHECK should move to btrim(rationale) <> '' at that time.
result.next_action: CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR to re-check §2.4 and §10's AC6 row against Ecto 3.14.1 source/runtime semantics, and confirm §2.2/§4.1/§4.2/§7 remain unchanged from the version already confirmed correct in step-01b-code-design-validator-recheck1.
